title: Access Governance (Lumos)
description: End-to-end implementation of Lumos identity governance platform — from vendor selection to change management and policy enforcement.
problem: Shadow IT and manual access provisioning created security risks and compliance gaps across the organization.
solution: Implemented Lumos for centralized access governance with SCIM-based auto-provisioning, role-based approval workflows, and end-to-end employee lifecycle management from onboarding to offboarding.
impact: Enhanced security compliance and eliminated Shadow IT across 20+ integrated applications.

title: Automated Onboarding Communication Platform
description: Built an automated multi-channel onboarding communication system integrating HRIS, Slack, and Gmail for standardized new hire engagement.
problem: Manual onboarding communications were inconsistent and time-consuming, leading to poor new hire experiences.
solution: Delivered 'OnCom App' on Google Apps Script integrating Keka HRIS, Slack API, and Gmail with configurable triggers, role-based admin controls, and automated scheduling for multi-channel onboarding messages.
impact: Standardized onboarding communications and reduced HR manual workload significantly.

title: Autonomous Maintenance & Equipment Care (WCM)
description: Implemented Autonomous Maintenance practices to improve equipment cleaning standards, inspection routines, and early fault detection.
problem: Operators lacked ownership of equipment maintenance, leading to recurring minor breakdowns and reliability issues.
solution: Trained operators on autonomous maintenance routines including standardized cleaning, inspection checklists, and early fault detection within the WCM framework.
impact: Improved equipment reliability and reduced minor breakdown frequency.

title: Business Trip & Expense Management System
description: Led acquisition and implementation of Rydoo as the enterprise expense management system with ERP and HRIS integrations.
problem: Manual expense handling caused slow reimbursements, weak compliance enforcement, and heavy administrative overhead.
solution: Implemented Rydoo with integrations to Odoo ERP and BambooHR, digitizing the full expense workflow from trip approval through automated reimbursement processing.
impact: Reduced reimbursement processing time by 70% and strengthened compliance enforcement.

title: Company Knowledge Management System
description: Led delivery of a centralized KMS to consolidate policies, SOPs, and governance documents with AI-powered search.
problem: Knowledge was scattered across drives, emails, and shared folders — making policies hard to find and maintain.
solution: Delivered a centralized KMS with document governance, automated review cycles, role-based access control, employee directory sync, and AI-powered intelligent search.
impact: Eliminated information silos and improved policy accessibility company-wide.

title: Contract Lifecycle System
description: Led initiative for a centralized contract management platform with AI-powered insights and role-based governance.
problem: Contracts were managed in spreadsheets with no visibility into renewals, expirations, or compliance status.
solution: Delivered a Django + React CMS with role-based access, audit trails, renewal tracking, automated notifications, and an AI-powered Gemini chatbot for contract insights.
impact: Reduced legal risks and decreased time for contract reporting and insight provisioning.

title: Custom Odoo Workflow Automation & Approval Engine
description: Designed custom approval workflows in Odoo to enforce role-based authorization across procurement, finance, and HR.
problem: Approval requests were handled informally, causing delays and policy non-compliance.
solution: Implemented role-based approval workflows in Odoo with automated routing, escalation rules, and policy enforcement across procurement, finance, and HR processes.
impact: Reduced approval cycle time and improved compliance with internal policies.

title: Digital Traceability Framework for Materials
description: Designed a traceability workflow to track materials from supplier receipt through production usage.
problem: Lack of standardized batch tracking created traceability gaps during audits and product launches.
solution: Implemented end-to-end material traceability from supplier receipt to production usage, standardizing batch tracking and data capture for audit readiness.
impact: Improved audit readiness and regulatory compliance for new product materials.

title: Early Defect Detection & Quality Feedback Loop
description: Introduced in-process inspection checkpoints and rapid feedback loops to catch defects early during manufacturing.
problem: Defects were detected too late in production, causing costly rework and yield losses.
solution: Introduced in-process inspection checkpoints and rapid operator feedback loops during scale-up phases, enabling earlier defect detection and reducing propagation.
impact: Improved first-pass yield and significantly reduced rework during product launches.

title: Employee Service Portal
description: Centralized web portal for employees to submit, track, and manage service requests with automated department routing.
problem: Employees used emails, WhatsApp, and paper forms for support requests, leading to lost tickets and no tracking.
solution: Built a self-service portal where employees raise, track, and rate service requests, with automated routing to the correct department.
impact: Streamlined request management and eliminated lost tickets.

title: Enterprise AI Assistant & Knowledge Platform
description: Designed and led implementation of an AI-powered Slack assistant for policy queries, HR lookups, and IT request automation.
problem: Employees couldn't quickly find policies or SOPs, creating support overhead and inconsistent information access.
solution: Built a RAG-based AI assistant on Google Cloud integrated with Slack, HRMS, and Notion — enabling conversational policy retrieval, IT ticket submission, and knowledge queries with source validation.
impact: Reduced internal support load and enabled instant, reliable answers for employees.

title: Enterprise Data Integration Hub (Odoo-Centric)
description: Led design of cross-system integrations between Odoo and core platforms to eliminate data silos.
problem: Critical data was siloed across BambooHR, Rydoo, Google Workspace, and internal portals with no synchronization.
solution: Designed and implemented integrations between Odoo and core platforms including BambooHR, Rydoo, internal portals, and Google Workspace for automated data exchange.
impact: Eliminated data silos and reduced manual reconciliation across departments.

title: ERP Governance & User Adoption Framework
description: Established governance standards for ERP usage including data ownership, user roles, and organization-wide training.
problem: Inconsistent ERP usage and workarounds across departments compromised data integrity.
solution: Defined data ownership rules, user role policies, and conducted training programs to ensure consistent ERP usage and reduce workarounds across departments.
impact: Improved system adoption and reduced process deviations.

title: Factory Operations Lead for Product Launches
description: Served as factory operations lead for 10+ new product launches, coordinating cross-functional readiness.
problem: Lack of coordinated readiness across planning, sourcing, and manufacturing caused launch delays and disruptions.
solution: Coordinated end-to-end launch readiness across planning, sourcing, manufacturing, quality, and warehousing for 10+ product launches, bridging R&D and factory operations.
impact: Reduced launch timelines and minimized operational disruptions during commercialization.

title: Fleet Asset Management System
description: Centralized tool for managing vehicles and garage assets, replacing fragmented Google Sheets with a unified platform.
problem: Operations team tracked fleet inventory across multiple Google Sheets with no validation or centralized visibility.
solution: Designed and managed delivery of a React + Node.js fleet management app with inventory, maintenance, analytics, access control modules, and Keka/Google SSO integrations.
impact: Increased data reliability and provided centralized visibility for operations and finance teams.

title: IWS Reliability & Maintenance Implementation
description: Deputy lead for Planned Maintenance pillar, strengthening engineering execution through standardized routines.
problem: Unplanned equipment stoppages and inconsistent maintenance routines were impacting production performance.
solution: Strengthened planned maintenance execution through standardized routines, performance tracking, and preventive maintenance practices, reducing unplanned stoppages.
impact: Improved equipment reliability and reduced unplanned stoppages during ramp-up.

title: IT Asset Management Platform
description: Built a custom web platform for centralized IT asset lifecycle management — from procurement to write-off.
problem: IT assets were tracked in spreadsheets with no lifecycle management, leading to inaccurate inventory and security gaps.
solution: Delivered a React-based ITAM platform with asset lifecycle tracking, warranty monitoring, work order management, role-based dashboards, SSO authentication, and audit logging.
impact: Reduced manual asset tracking effort and improved inventory accuracy significantly.

title: IT Performance Dashboard
description: Enterprise reporting dashboard built in Looker Studio for real-time IT support performance analytics via Jira data.
problem: IT support performance was invisible — no metrics on SLA compliance, workload distribution, or resolution trends.
solution: Built an end-to-end data pipeline from Jira to BigQuery to Looker Studio, computing SLA success rates, workload distribution, and performance benchmarks per team and coordinator.
impact: Enabled data-driven IT support management with real-time SLA tracking and team benchmarking.

title: JML Request Automation & Jira Provisioning
description: Digitized Joiner/Mover/Leaver requests with automated Jira ticket creation and admin approval workflows.
problem: Employee lifecycle changes (JML) required manual ticket creation and lacked structured approval workflows.
solution: Built a GAS + Google Sheets workflow for JML requests with admin approval console, automated Jira issue creation via REST API, background processing, audit logging, and role-based access control.
impact: Automated IT provisioning for employee lifecycle changes, eliminating manual ticket creation.

title: Line Changeover Time Reduction
description: Led cross-functional effort to reduce changeover time through reorganized staging and standardized procedures.
problem: Long changeover times between product variants reduced line flexibility and increased downtime.
solution: Reorganized tool staging, material preparation, and operator sequencing with standardized checklists and pre-staging practices to reduce changeover time.
impact: Improved changeover efficiency and increased line flexibility during product introductions.

title: Line-Side Material Flow Optimization
description: Reorganized line-side storage and material positioning to reduce operator movement and prevent line interruptions.
problem: Poor material positioning caused excessive operator movement and frequent line interruptions.
solution: Reorganized line-side storage areas and optimized material handling practices to reduce operator movement and prevent production line interruptions.
impact: Improved production continuity and reduced handling inefficiencies.

title: NOC Monitoring Dashboards
description: Centralized health monitoring dashboard for telecom services with automated alerts for potential threats.
problem: Support teams only discovered downtime after customer complaints, damaging service reputation.
solution: Created a centralized 'Heartbeat' dashboard aggregating statuses from Infobip, Ziwo, and Maqsam APIs with instant alerts to on-call engineers.
impact: Enabled proactive issue detection and reduced downtime response time.

title: NPI Launch Visibility Dashboard
description: Centralized launch dashboard consolidating cross-functional inputs into a single readiness view for leadership.
problem: Launch progress was tracked in scattered spreadsheets with no consolidated visibility for leadership.
solution: Built an automated Excel/VBA dashboard consolidating inputs from planning, warehousing, and production teams to track milestones, risks, and dependencies in real time.
impact: Reduced manual reporting effort by 70% and improved launch decision turnaround time.

title: NPI Readiness & Scale-Up Framework
description: Developed a structured readiness framework with checkpoints and governance routines for new product launches.
problem: Launches lacked structured readiness criteria, leading to ~5-month lead times and unreliable execution.
solution: Created a structured readiness framework with checkpoints, KPIs, and cross-functional governance routines, coordinating execution across sourcing, planning, manufacturing, and quality.
impact: Reduced launch lead time from ~5 months to ~2 months with improved reliability.

title: Odoo Finance & Operations Module Implementation
description: Led implementation and configuration of core Odoo modules for Purchase, Inventory, Finance, and HR workflows.
problem: Financial and operational workflows were manual and disconnected from the ERP system.
solution: Implemented core Odoo modules (Purchase, Inventory, Finance, HR), defined approval flows, and integrated with procurement and expense systems.
impact: Standardized financial workflows and improved process traceability across departments.

title: Odoo Reporting & Operational Insights
description: Designed custom Odoo reporting views and dashboards for real-time operational KPI visibility.
problem: Leadership lacked real-time visibility into operational KPIs and financial metrics from the ERP.
solution: Designed custom reporting views and dashboards in Odoo for operational KPIs, financial metrics, and procurement performance visibility.
impact: Enabled real-time operational insights and reduced manual report preparation.

title: Onboarding Automation Platform
description: End-to-end hiring automation from headcount approval through AI-powered CV screening to pre-onboarding workflows.
problem: HR onboarding involved manual data entry, fragmented tools, and no automated candidate screening.
solution: Built a Google Apps Script platform automating the full hiring pipeline: headcount approvals, AI-generated job descriptions, CV screening via OpenAI/Gemini, candidate shortlisting, and pre-onboarding document collection.
impact: Eliminated manual data entry for new hires and automated the end-to-end hiring pipeline.

title: Payroll Automation Engine
description: Custom Odoo module that consolidates employee data from multiple systems and automates payroll calculation and reporting.
problem: Payroll calculation took 4+ days involving 3-4 team members across finance and HR with manual data gathering.
solution: Developed a custom Odoo module (v16→v18) integrating BambooHR, Rydoo, and internal portals to auto-fetch salary, leave, expense, and loan data — generating complete payroll reports with one click.
impact: Reduced payroll calculation from 4 days to under 1 hour.

title: Procure-to-Pay Digitization (Odoo + Penny)
description: Designed the end-to-end digital procurement workflow integrating Penny with Odoo Finance.
problem: Procurement was handled manually with no audit trail or automated financial reconciliation.
solution: Designed the end-to-end procurement workflow integrating Penny platform with Odoo Finance for automated purchase tracking, invoice alignment, and financial reconciliation.
impact: Increased spend visibility and reduced procurement processing time.

title: Production Line Efficiency & OEE Improvement
description: Led multiple line improvement initiatives to reduce stoppages, improve balance, and eliminate operational inefficiencies.
problem: Frequent minor stoppages and poor line balance were reducing OEE and production throughput.
solution: Led cross-functional improvement initiatives with operators, maintenance, and supervisors to address root causes of downtime, reduce stoppages, and streamline line operations.
impact: Improved OEE, reduced unplanned stoppages, and increased production throughput.

title: Production Loss & Downtime Analytics
description: Power BI dashboards analyzing downtime categories, loss trends, and shift performance across production lines.
problem: Production losses and downtime causes were not systematically tracked or visualized for action.
solution: Designed Power BI dashboards consolidating operational data to visualize downtime categories, loss trends, and shift performance for daily reviews and root cause prioritization.
impact: Improved visibility into loss drivers and enabled data-driven improvement actions.

title: Production Planning & Material Readiness Automation
description: Automation tools consolidating production, inventory, and warehouse data for improved planning accuracy.
problem: Planning relied on manual data consolidation across production, inventory, and warehouse systems.
solution: Deployed automation tools to consolidate production, inventory, and warehouse data, reducing manual planning effort by ~50% and improving material availability visibility.
impact: Reduced manual planning effort by 50% and improved material availability during scale-up.

title: Quality Defect Reduction & Yield Improvement
description: Strengthened defect detection practices and operator feedback loops to improve first-pass yield.
problem: High defect rates and late detection were causing excessive rework and yield losses.
solution: Worked with quality and production teams to introduce improved in-process checks and operator feedback loops, reducing defect propagation and supporting yield improvements.
impact: Improved first-pass yield and reduced rework across production lines.

title: Real-Time Production KPI Dashboards
description: Automated production KPI dashboards tracking output, efficiency, downtime, and quality in near real-time.
problem: Production reporting was manual, delaying shift-level performance reviews and corrective actions.
solution: Developed automated dashboards tracking output, efficiency, downtime, and quality in near real-time, replacing manual reporting routines.
impact: Reduced reporting preparation time by 60% and enabled faster corrective actions.

title: SafeSpeak – Employee Grievance Platform
description: Confidential employee grievance reporting module with structured submission, investigation workflows, and SLA tracking.
problem: Employees had no safe, structured channel to submit complaints or grievances with confidentiality guarantees.
solution: Designed a confidential grievance module integrated into the Internal Portal with anonymous reporting, investigation SLAs, two-way communication, and auto-escalation to Legal when needed.
impact: Established a trusted channel for employee grievances with investigation SLA compliance.

title: AI Policy Summarizer
description: AI-powered pipeline that ingests policy PDFs, extracts content via Document AI, and generates structured summaries.
problem: Manually reviewing and summarizing corporate policies was time-consuming and resulted in inconsistent documentation.
solution: Built a GAS-orchestrated pipeline using Google Document AI for OCR extraction and Vertex AI Gemini for summary refinement, processing new policy PDFs automatically every 10 minutes into a structured knowledge base.
impact: Automated policy processing and improved accessibility of corporate governance information.

title: Standard Work & Workflow Optimization (WCM)
description: Workflow gap analysis and standardized operating practices implementation aligned with WCM standards.
problem: Inconsistent operating practices across teams were undermining KPI performance and execution quality.
solution: Conducted workflow gap analyses and implemented standardized operating practices aligned with WCM standards, reinforcing adherence to standard work across production teams.
impact: Improved execution consistency and supported KPI performance improvements.

title: Odoo ERP Version Upgrade Program
description: Led Odoo upgrade across major versions (v13→v16→v18), coordinating data migration and module compatibility.
problem: Outdated ERP version limited functionality and posed security and scalability risks.
solution: Led the Odoo upgrade from v13 through v16 to v18, coordinating data migration, module compatibility assessment, user acceptance testing, and post-migration stabilization.
impact: Improved system performance, security, and scalability across the organization.

title: Supplier Capacity & Continuity Program
description: Led supplier capacity assessments and contingency planning to ensure supply continuity during product launches.
problem: Supply disruptions during product launches were caused by unassessed supplier capacity constraints.
solution: Conducted supplier capacity assessments and developed contingency plans in collaboration with suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure on-time material availability during ramp-up.
impact: Reduced supply disruption risks and improved on-time material availability.

title: Supplier Performance Monitoring
description: Structured tracking of supplier delivery performance, material quality, and OTIF compliance.
problem: Supplier performance issues impacting production were not systematically tracked or reported.
solution: Introduced structured tracking practices and reporting routines for supplier delivery performance, material quality, and OTIF compliance to enable faster issue resolution.
impact: Improved visibility into supplier performance and faster resolution of supply issues.

title: Supply Team Ticketing Automation
description: Slack-to-Jira ticket automation with interactive approval, email intake, and full lifecycle tracking.
problem: Supply team ticket requests were handled ad-hoc via Slack messages with no tracking or accountability.
solution: Built a GAS automation connecting Slack Events and Jira REST API — detecting supply team mentions, posting interactive approval buttons, creating Jira tickets with custom fields, and posting confirmation links back to Slack threads.
impact: Automated ticket creation from Slack and email, eliminating manual tracking.

title: Universal Ticketing (Jira)
description: Jira-based ticketing system integrated with Slack for unified cross-functional project tracking.
problem: Tech and non-tech teams worked in silos using different tools, making cross-functional tracking impossible.
solution: Unified all teams onto a single Jira instance with customized workflows and a Slack bot for direct ticket management from chat.
impact: Improved resolution time and cross-functional collaboration.

title: Visual Factory & Shift Communication Boards
description: Implemented visual management boards displaying production targets, downtime causes, and quality alerts.
problem: Information gaps between shifts led to slow responses and misaligned priorities on the factory floor.
solution: Deployed visual management boards standardizing communication of production targets, downtime causes, quality alerts, and maintenance status across shift handovers.
impact: Improved operator awareness and reduced information gaps between shifts.

title: Warehouse Material Flow & Staging Optimization
description: Redesigned staging zones and delivery timing to ensure timely material delivery to production lines.
problem: Poorly organized staging areas caused operator waiting time and line interruptions during ramp-up.
solution: Redesigned staging zones and delivery timing to reduce operator waiting time and improve line continuity during increased launch volumes.
impact: Reduced operator waiting time and improved line continuity during ramp-up.
